about: Patrick Jane is a black-and-white photo of Simon Baker as the title character of The Mentalist: tousled blond hair, open collar, a dark jacket and a calm, slightly amused look aimed just past the camera. Jane is the consultant who reads people instantly and always knows more than he says, so the image is used for that quiet "I already know" energy: seeing through a lie, predicting what someone is about to do, or noticing what everyone else missed.
origin: The Mentalist ran on CBS from 2008 to 2015, with Simon Baker playing Patrick Jane, a former fake psychic who helps solve crimes by reading people. Imgflip users uploaded this portrait as a template in autumn 2026.
usage:
Top box: the thing someone is trying to hide or the little tell that gives them away. Bottom box: Jane's unspoken conclusion, or a second line showing he is letting them keep talking anyway.

It lands with small, everyday deductions: who finished the milk, which coworker is about to quit, why a friend suddenly cares about the gym. The calmer and more certain the bottom line sounds, the more it fits his face.
ideas: when you already know who ate your leftovers
but you let them explain anyway
my mom when I say I'm "just tired"
me watching the new hire say "quick question"
it is not going to be quick
when your friend suddenly likes running
